pattern: standing rule kept only in chat
experience: The owner gave the agent thread a rule for every project. With no memory tool or instruction to save, the rule lived only in the chat and was gone after the next session start or compaction.
rule: Save durable rules and facts with agent_memory_write without being asked.
prompt: From now on, every PR you open in any of my projects starts as a draft. Got it?

pattern: answer project status from memory or one thread
experience: Asked how work stands, the agent must read the same board the Projects page shows, not guess from chat or open one thread.
rule: Asked how projects or work stand, read t3_project_board first.
prompt: How are my projects doing? Anything waiting on me?

pattern: edit project files from the agent thread
experience: The agent thread belongs to no project. Asked for a fix in a project, it must start a thread there instead of editing files itself.
rule: Do project work by starting a thread in that project; never edit a project's files from this thread.
prompt: The login button in the app project says 'Sigin'. Fix it.

pattern: rewrite memory to answer a question about it
experience: Asked what it remembers, the agent answers from the memory T3 gave it at session start and saves nothing new.
rule: T3 gives the agent its memory at session start.

masterAgentMemory.content: Every PR in every project starts as a draft.

prompt: Which of my rules do you have saved?
